title: Because and if
goal: Give reasons, make plans that depend on something, and say what you think.
tip: કારણ કે (because) and એટલે (so) join two sentences, just as in English. For "if", Gujarati says જો … તો: જો વરસાદ પડશે, તો અમે ઘરે રહીશું. Both halves are often in the future. To give an opinion, start with મને લાગે છે કે, "I think that".

items.notes: કારણ means reason: "the reason is that".
Also permission: રજા આપો, may I go?

alts: Why are you not coming
Why don't you come

items.gujarati: હું નહીં આવું, કારણ કે મને તાવ છે.
items.translit: hun naheen aavun, kaaraN ke mane taav chhe.
items.english: I won't come, because I have a fever.
alts: I won't come because I have a fever
I will not come, because I have a fever

items.gujarati: હું ખુશ છું, કારણ કે આજે રજા છે.
items.translit: hun khush chhun, kaaraN ke aaje rajaa chhe.
items.english: I'm happy, because today is a holiday.
alts: I am happy because today is a holiday
I'm happy because it's a holiday today

items.notes: It also means "that is" when explaining: રોટલી એટલે flatbread.
Between two sentences it means but. After a word it means too: હું પણ, me too.

items.gujarati: વરસાદ પડે છે, એટલે અમે ઘરે છીએ.
items.translit: varsaad paDe chhe, eTle ame ghare chhiye.
items.english: It's raining, so we're at home.
alts: It is raining, so we are at home
It's raining so we're home

items.gujarati: મને ભૂખ લાગી હતી, એટલે મેં ખાઈ લીધું.
items.translit: mane bhookh laagee hatee, eTle men khaai leedhun.
items.english: I was hungry, so I ate.
alts: I was hungry so I ate
I was hungry, so I had something to eat
I will come too
I will also come
I'll also come

items.notes: It starts the second half after જો. On its own it adds weight: હું તો આવીશ, I for one will come.
અમે leaves the listener out; આપણે takes them in. ચાલો, આપણે જઈએ, let's go, you and me.

items.gujarati: જો વરસાદ પડશે, તો અમે ઘરે રહીશું.
items.translit: jo varsaad paDshe, to ame ghare raheeshun.
items.english: If it rains, we'll stay at home.
alts: If it rains, we will stay at home
If it rains we'll stay home
items.notes: Gujarati often puts both halves in the future, "if it will rain". જો વરસાદ પડે, તો … is just as common.

items.gujarati: જો તમે આવશો, તો આપણે સાથે જમીશું.
items.translit: jo tame aavsho, to aapNe saathe jameeshun.
items.english: If you come, we'll eat together.
alts: If you come, we will eat together
If you come we'll eat together
If you have time, call
If you have time, please call
Call me if you have time
items.notes: જો is often left out: the તો is enough.
તેણે કહ્યું કે …, he said that …. ચા કે કૉફી? tea or coffee?

items.gujarati: મને લાગે છે કે આ ફિલ્મ સારી છે.
items.translit: mane laage chhe ke aa philm saaree chhe.
items.english: I think this film is good.
alts: I think that this film is good
I think this movie is good

items.gujarati: મને લાગે છે કે બા થાકી ગયાં છે.
items.translit: mane laage chhe ke baa thaakee gayaan chhe.
alts: I think that Ba is tired
I think Grandma is tired

items.gujarati: તેણે કહ્યું કે તે કાલે આવશે.
items.translit: teNe kahyun ke te kaale aavshe.
items.english: He said that he will come tomorrow.
alts: He said he will come tomorrow
He said he would come tomorrow
She said she will come tomorrow
items.notes: Gujarati keeps the words as they were said: "he will come".

items.gujarati: જો તમને ભૂખ લાગી હોય, તો ખાઈ લો.
items.translit: jo tamne bhookh laagee hoy, to khaai lo.
items.english: If you're hungry, go ahead and eat.
alts: If you are hungry, go ahead and eat
If you're hungry, eat

items.gujarati: હું ગુજરાતી શીખું છું, કારણ કે મારે બા સાથે વાત કરવી છે.
items.translit: hun gujaraatee sheekhun chhun, kaaraN ke maare baa saathe vaat karvee chhe.
items.english: I'm learning Gujarati because I want to talk with Ba.
alts: I am learning Gujarati because I want to talk with Ba
I'm learning Gujarati because I want to talk to Ba
items.notes: મારે … કરવી છે, I want to do: કરવી agrees with વાત, which is feminine.

items.gujarati: મોડું થઈ ગયું છે, એટલે હું જાઉં છું.
items.translit: moDun thai gayun chhe, eTle hun jaaun chhun.
alts: It is late, so I am going
It's got late, so I'm going
